acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:9787c187-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Senior Security Engineer at Vanta, you’ll own projects with impact across the business to help us run an efficient and highly effective security team. The security team at Vanta ensures that we are a trustworthy steward of sensitive data. We also contribute subject matter expertise to the product, sales, marketing, support, and engineering functions, given the nature of our business. You’ll join Vanta’s Security organization, which provides essential security operational services, is directly involved in the software development process and building tools to make it easy for developers to ship products securely, sets policies and standards regarding enterprise-wide security requirements, and offers advisory services to enable our business to thrive while effectively managing risk. If you’re someone who has high initiative and enjoys problem solving while having impact at a high-growth company, we would love to hear from you! What you’ll do as a Senior Security Engineer at Vanta: - Participate in team exercises to identify potential security risks, including threat modeling and tabletop scenarios - Contribute to complex prioritization discussions around which risks are the most important to solve next - Plan projects to address the risks we prioritize, and coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to execute those projects - Build maintainable programs to implement operational excellence where ongoing work is needed to achieve our goals (e.g. vulnerability management) - Partner with engineering teams to architect secure software, address security concerns, and build a strong security culture - Build, customize, and run tools to increase the maturity of our security program without adding undue friction to the company’s operations - Support ongoing bug bounty and penetration testing programs - Establish and maintain a network of security champions - Understand security knowledge gaps of the development organization and help to deliver training to address gaps - Provide input into architectural discussions to enable teams to innovate in a secure and repeatable manner How to be successful in this role: - A track record of independent ownership of areas of responsibility - Experience with threat modeling, red teaming, penetration testing, or other means of identifying security issues - Experience with software development and the ability to read code to identify security issues - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with deep developer empathy - Highly organized project management skills - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:fedc71ba-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our Senior Software Engineers lead and mentor engineers, delivering high-value products for our customers and infrastructure that enables our business to scale. Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for setting technical direction to enable our product and infrastructure to scale with our business, driving complex projects across our technical stack, and mentoring our talented engineering team. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta’s growth. Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! The GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) organization is the primary org responsible for developing and maintaining Vanta's core product offerings. These teams are at the heart of Vanta moving upmarket to support enterprise customers and build products that enable our customers’ existing security and compliance programs to integrate seamlessly with Vanta, giving them invaluable insights and recommendations to continue to operate, mature and evolve their programs. What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta: - Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to deliver significant impact to our business - Set direction for critical technical surface areas, enabling us to stay ahead of continued rapid growth - Design, develop, and own new product functionality and/or infrastructure leveraging modern frameworks and tooling (TypeScript, React, Node.js) - Work with talented and kind engineers to make a significant impact on our customer base, enabling them to improve their security and prove it - Contribute to building Vanta’s engineering culture as we grow How to be successful in this role: - Have at least 8 years of industry experience - Have played technical leadership roles for teams or complex projects - Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action - Have previous experience working on greenfield projects - Have an interest in learning about security or prior experience in the space What you can expect as a US-based Vanta'n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family planning benefits - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time - 11 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as an Attorney at Axiom We are seeking a Banking & Financial Regulatory Counsel to join our Financial Institutions team. This role centers on regulatory compliance, capital management, and complex lending transactions . We are looking for a hands-on attorney with deep expertise in Basel III capital requirements, AML/KYC frameworks, and OCC regulations , as well as experience structuring syndicated loans and secured lending arrangements . The ideal candidate will bring strong familiarity with interbank transaction frameworks , combined with practical transactional and compliance capabilities across regulated banking and financial services environments. Responsibilities: Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating loan documentation, credit agreements, security documents, and intercreditor agreements related to syndicated loans and secured lending arrangements. Providing legal guidance on Basel III capital management requirements, AML/KYC compliance obligations, and OCC regulatory matters . Collaborating with internal stakeholders, compliance teams, risk management, and external counsel on lending transactions, regulatory initiatives, and interbank transactions . Managing regulatory, transactional, and compliance-related legal issues for clients within the banking and financial services sector . Staying ahead of evolving banking regulations, capital adequacy standards, and financial crime compliance requirements to provide proactive, strategic legal counsel. Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in commercial banking, financial regulation, or lending transactions . Strong knowledge of Basel III requirements, AML/KYC frameworks, OCC regulations, and interbank transaction structures . Proven track record of advising clients on syndicated loans, secured lending arrangements, and regulatory compliance initiatives . Excellent communication, negotiation, technology, and problem-solving skills. Juris Doctor (JD) degree and licensed to practice law in an applicable jurisdiction. Preferred Skills: Experience with trade finance, receivables, payables, and supply chain or inventory financing . Familiarity with working with bank regulators and supporting regulatory examinations or remediation efforts . Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. About Axiom: For over 25 years, Axiom has pioneered the alternative legal services industry, now serving more than 1,500 legal departments globally with our unique blend of world-class legal talent and advanced AI tools, delivering innovative solutions ranging from that combine top-tier talent with cutting-edge technology. We tackle complex legal matters across 12 practice areas for clients ranging from Fortune 100 to SMBs, empowering our legal professionals to engage in meaningful work that advances their careers. Our Talent NPS score of +71% and our Client NPS score of +64% highlight our commitment to excellence ( Reported scores were Axiom’s average for 2025 – the legal industry average NPS score is +35% ). Join our forward-thinking community where you’ll keep your career dynamic and multi-faceted, be part of a company that values agility, collaboration, and excellence, and love both the law and your life. Learn more about life at Axiom . Axiom is the global leader in high-caliber, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in class alterative legal services. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2e.title: Automotive Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2e.description: Primary Role Summary The Automotive Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining customer vehicles safely, efficiently, and in accordance with manufacturer and company standards. The Technician plays a critical role in delivering quality repairs, identifying additional service opportunities, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The Automotive Technician serves as the technical expert within the shop, providing accurate inspections, quality workmanship, and professional recommendations that support customer safety, vehicle reliability, and company profitability. Key Responsibilities 1. Vehicle Diagnostics & Repair Perform vehicle inspections and diagnostic testing. Identify mechanical, electrical, drivability, and performance issues. Diagnose root causes and recommend corrective actions. Perform repairs according to manufacturer specifications and company standards. Complete maintenance services including brakes, tires, alignments, oil changes, suspension, batteries, and other vehicle systems. Verify repairs through testing and quality control procedures. 2. Inspection & Customer Recommendations Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections. Identify maintenance and repair opportunities. Document inspection findings accurately. Communicate repair recommendations clearly to Service Advisors. Support customer safety and preventative maintenance programs. Assist in maximizing vehicle reliability and customer satisfaction. 3. Productivity & Workflow Management Maintain efficient work habits and productivity levels. Complete assigned work within established labor times. Manage workflow and prioritize assignments effectively. Support overall shop throughput and scheduling objectives. Minimize delays and operational bottlenecks. 4. Quality Control & Workmanship Ensure repairs are completed correctly the first time. Follow shop quality control procedures. Conduct final inspections and testing prior to vehicle release. Minimize comeback repairs and warranty work. Maintain high standards of workmanship and professionalism. 5. Safety, Equipment & Facility Care Follow OSHA, EPA, and company safety requirements. Utilize tools, lifts, and diagnostic equipment properly. Maintain a clean and organized work area. Properly handle and dispose of hazardous materials. Report damaged equipment and safety concerns immediately. Protect customer vehicles and company assets. 6. Documentation & Communication Complete repair order notes accurately and thoroughly. Document diagnostic findings, repairs performed, and recommendations. Communicate effectively with Service Advisors and management. Maintain accurate labor and time records. Participate in production meetings and training activities. 7. Continuous Improvement & Training Stay current with automotive technology and repair procedures. Participate in technical training and certification programs. Develop advanced diagnostic and repair skills. Support mentorship and knowledge sharing within the shop. Promote a culture of professionalism and continuous improvement.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6810676d-3f6e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate - Pricing & Actuarial Analyst based in the United States. This fully remote role supports government acquisition and proposal evaluation through rigorous pricing, actuarial, financial, and healthcare analysis. You will assess complex proposals, validate analytical models, and identify inconsistencies, unsupported assumptions, and potential areas requiring further review. Your work will directly contribute to accurate, transparent, and well-supported government decision-making. The role combines quantitative analysis with careful documentation, quality control, and clear written communication. You will collaborate with pricing and actuarial professionals to reconcile data, assumptions, and analytical conclusions in a highly controlled environment. The position also offers opportunities to apply approved automation and analytics tools while maintaining confidentiality, traceability, and human oversight. It is an excellent opportunity for an analytical professional seeking meaningful work at the intersection of finance, actuarial science, healthcare, and public-sector programs. Review offeror proposals for completeness, internal consistency, mathematical accuracy, and compliance with applicable pricing and actuarial evaluation frameworks. Develop and maintain reproducible analytical models, comparison matrices, crosswalks, sensitivity analyses, and structured evaluation workpapers. Analyze pricing, financial, actuarial, healthcare, and cost-modeling information to support acquisition and proposal evaluations. Identify unsupported assumptions, anomalies, missing inputs, inconsistent rates, and other issues requiring clarification or additional analysis. Evaluate calculations and underlying assumptions, ensuring analytical conclusions are accurate, defensible, and traceable to source information. Draft concise clarification questions, evaluation observations, briefing materials, and negotiation-support inputs for government stakeholders. Collaborate with pricing and actuarial teams to reconcile differences in data, assumptions, methodologies, and analytical conclusions. Rapidly update models and analyses in response to clarifications, revised proposals, final proposal revisions, and contracting direction. Apply rigorous version control, calculation validation, source traceability, and peer-review practices across all deliverables. Use approved automation and analytical technologies to improve consistency, efficiency, and quality while preserving confidentiality and human oversight. Produce clear, organized, and audit-ready documentation that can support official acquisition or contract records. Manage multiple analytical priorities and deliver accurate work within compressed timelines and a highly controlled professional environment. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Business, Healthcare Analytics, or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, actuarial analysis, healthcare analytics, cost modeling, or a closely related discipline. At least 1 year of experience building or reviewing complex analytical models, evaluating assumptions and calculations, and communicating findings through clear written deliverables. At least 1 year of experience applying strong quality-control practices, reconciling complex data, and delivering accurate analytical work under tight deadlines. Advanced Excel and quantitative analysis capabilities, with strong attention to detail and analytical judgment. Ability to create structured, reproducible models and clearly document methodologies, assumptions, calculations, and conclusions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:dd09fa8b-54b8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Recruiting and HR Administrator based in the United States. This role serves as a key operational partner across both recruiting and human resources, keeping people processes organized, accurate, and moving forward. You will coordinate recruiting activities from job posting and candidate screening through interviews, offers, and pre-boarding. You will also support core HR administration, including HRIS management, employee records, onboarding, reporting, and compliance tracking. The position requires strong ownership, as you will be expected to identify bottlenecks, follow up proactively, and resolve routine issues without waiting for direction. You will act as a trusted first point of contact for candidates, employees, and managers while escalating sensitive or complex matters appropriately. With approximately 60% recruiting operations and 40% HR administration, the balance of responsibilities will adapt to hiring needs and business priorities. This remote or hybrid opportunity is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative and fast-moving environment. Manage recruiting operations from requisition launch through candidate start date, including drafting, formatting, publishing, refreshing, and closing job postings across relevant career sites, job boards, LinkedIn, and professional or diversity-focused channels. Ensure job postings contain required compliance, pay-transparency, equal employment opportunity, and applicable preference language before publication. Review applications against documented, job-related criteria, conduct initial candidate screens, assess qualifications and availability, and provide hiring teams with concise recommendations. Coordinate phone, virtual, and in-person interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and technical panels in multiple time zones, including confirmations, agendas, interview materials, and feedback follow-up. Serve as a reliable point of contact throughout the candidate journey, ensuring timely communication and coordinating travel or reimbursement logistics when required. Prepare offer documentation and new-hire paperwork for approval, initiate and track background checks, drug screening, references, and applicable clearance processes, and ensure smooth handoffs to onboarding. Maintain accurate and up-to-date applicant, requisition, and compliance records, including data required for federal contractor reporting, and produce recurring recruiting pipeline reports. Administer the HRIS on a day-to-day basis, including employee and job data, user permissions, workflows, templates, requisitions, offers, documents, reporting, and data audits. Process employee lifecycle transactions such as new hires, job and status changes, transfers, and separations while maintaining confidential personnel, I-9, and related records in accordance with retention requirements. Coordinate onboarding and orientation logistics, including new-hire materials, equipment, systems access, accounts, and day-one readiness. Prepare recurring and ad hoc HR reports covering headcount, turnover, open requisitions, time-to-fill, and relevant compliance data, while supporting audits, benefits renewals, and external information requests. Maintain HR and recruiting procedures, checklists, templates, trackers, calendars, meeting notes, and action items to ensure processes remain organized and current. Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee, manager, and candidate questions related to HR processes, PTO, payroll timing, benefits enrollment mechanics, HRIS navigation, employment verification, and recruiting status. Escalate questions involving policy interpretation, benefits, payroll, legal matters, or other sensitive issues with the relevant facts, documentation, and context already gathered. pineservices-pine-services:lever:136585c.title: Senior Director of Finance
pineservices-pine-services:lever:136585c.description: One of Pine's portfolio companies, Alliance Solutions Group, is a leading Sage Intacct partner for the construction industry and a fast-growing professional services organization. As Alliance continues to scale, they are investing in the leadership, infrastructure, and insights needed to support their next stage of growth. They're looking for a Senior Director of Finance to serve as a strategic business partner to their leadership team — helping shape how the company plans, measures, and makes decisions across the business. This role sits at the intersection of financial planning, business intelligence, and business strategy — translating financial and operational data into clear insights that help leaders understand performance, evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions. The right candidate will bring an Alliance-first mindset, move comfortably between the details and the bigger picture, and help Alliance scale with confidence. This is a fully remote role reporting directly to the CEO, with a seat on the Executive Leadership Team. Quarterly travel is expected for leadership offsites. Strategic Business Partnership Serve as a strategic advisor to the leadership team, bringing a financial and business perspective to company planning, investment decisions, organizational priorities, and growth initiatives. Act as the financial business partner to department leaders — developing a deep understanding of their operations, challenges, and opportunities, and translating data into actionable insights that drive stronger, faster decisions. Partner with the Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness on workforce and organizational planning, including headcount strategy, organizational design, and resource allocation. Build business cases, model scenarios, assess ROI and risk, and clearly articulate tradeoffs so leadership can make informed decisions about where and how Alliance invests for growth. Financial Planning & Analysis Own the company's financial planning and forecasting framework, including the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning, and monthly performance reporting. Build financial models and business cases that inform strategic decisions — including investments, new offerings, organizational changes, and headcount planning. Own performance against key financial and commercial targets, including EBITDA, partner incentives, and recurring revenue. Identify emerging risks and opportunities early. Partner with the CEO on board and investor reporting, developing clear financial narratives that communicate performance, outlook, key drivers, and strategic priorities. Controller & Order Processing Oversight Lead, develop, and partner with the Controller and broader Finance team — establishing strong operating rhythms, controls, reporting standards, and accountability across the function. Oversee the financial components of the order-to-revenue lifecycle, ensuring accurate deal booking, billing readiness, provisioning coordination, and strong handoffs across Sales, Finance, and Delivery. Continuously evaluate and improve Finance systems, processes, and automation to simplify workflows, strengthen data integrity, and build infrastructure that scales with the business. Revenue & Business Intelligence Own revenue and commercial analytics at the strategic level, providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health, bookings, revenue performance, renewals, retention, and churn. Lead deeper analysis of the drivers behind company performance, including customer and product segmentation, retention and churn trends, expansion opportunities, and service-line economics. Support pricing, packaging, and investment decisions by developing financial models that evaluate economics, scalability, ROI, and potential business impact. Partner closely with Sales leadership on forecasting and pipeline analytics, improving the predictability of future performance. Required 7–12+ years of progressive experience in FP&A

regent-regent:greenhouse:8064609.title: Recruiter
regent-regent:greenhouse:8064609.description: About Regent: Regent is a global private holding company headquartered in Los Angeles, focused on acquiring and transforming businesses across a wide range of industries including technology, consumer products, retail, industrial, and media. Regent’s investment approach centres on unlocking growth through operational transformation, innovation, and strategic leadership. As Regent continues expanding its global footprint, we are seeking an experienced Recruiter to support talent acquisition for leadership and critical roles across our portfolio and corporate teams, with a focus on Europe-based operations. Position Overview: The Recruiter will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing top-tier executive and senior leadership talent across Regent's portfolio companies and corporate functions. This London-based role will report to the Executive Recruiter in London, with a dotted reporting line to the Managing Partner, Europe. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of private equity, operations, and talent strategy, helping to shape leadership teams that drive transformation and value creation. Key Responsibilities: • Executive Search Execution: Lead end-to-end recruitment processes for C-suite, VP, and senior-level hires across Europe, spanning portfolio companies and Regent’s internal functions. • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Operating Partners, portfolio company CEOs, and Regent’s leadership team to understand hiring needs and define role requirements. • Candidate Identification: Proactively source, assess, and engage high-calibre candidates using direct sourcing, executive search methodologies, and Regent’s network. • Process Management: Oversee interview coordination, candidate assessments, offer negotiations, and onboarding support. • Market Intelligence: Provide insights on executive talent trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitive landscape in relevant sectors. • Talent Pipelining: Build and maintain a strategic talent pipeline for anticipated hiring needs across the European region. • Candidate Experience: Ensure a high-touch, professional candidate experience that reflects Regent’s brand and values.
